name: Nana
source:
"[i]Being held tight is embarrassing... Being roughed up and messed with is... just too much. It makes me want to cry.[/i]"

A certain someone who dwells in the [b]night[/b] of Sanzenchou,
the town where Taiga and the others live.
Perhaps she’s a spirit of the trains. Perhaps she’s a god.

At first glance she appears quiet and expressionless,
but once she opens up to someone, she is surprisingly talkative.

She cannot leave the [b]old steam locomotive[/b] that serves as her home,
but from time to time the protagonist comes to visit and keeps her company.

She has an unusual fondness for cup noodles.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 112cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B72 / W49 / H77
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Cup noodles. Snacks. Junk food. Sometimes sweets too.
[i]Blood type[/i]: AB
[i]Birthday[/i]: December 24th

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]
